witnesses.separates: train0 input with the card's solid 0 block at rows 13-15, cols 17-19 recolored 5: the key's solid 0 block is on the card only in another color; the concept calls nothing there and loses, and ignoring color calls that slot and completes card row 1

train0 input with the key's 6 shape moved one column left in its slot, to cols 17-18: its slot content no longer equals the card slot at rows 13-15, cols 12-14; the concept calls three slots and loses, and matching up to translation calls the fourth and wins
train4 input with the card slot at rows 23-25, cols 2-4 holding the key's 9 shape mirrored left to right: the concept leaves that slot unringed, and matching up to D4 rings it
a 2 by 2 card whose slots are 4 cells apart: the called slots of row 0 take a ring 1 cell wide under the concept, and a ring 2 cells wide, the lattice cell, under the lattice-cell halo
train4 input with the key's first slot holding the solid 0 block: the called slots are three of card column 3; the concept finds no complete line and loses, and the collinear reading wins
train0 input with the key holding the four card slots of the main diagonal: the concept finds no complete row or column and loses, and the reading with diagonals wins

train0 input with the card slot at rows 8-10, cols 7-9 also holding the solid 0 block: the key calls all of card row 1 and that extra slot; the concept wins on the complete row, and the reading that every called slot lies on the complete line loses

train2 input with a 1 cell at (29,0) in the status panel: the losing bar paints only the background cells under the concept, keeping that cell, and paints the whole panel under the whole-status reading
train0 input at halo_color 4: the rings are 4 under both; the winning bars stay win_color 3 under the concept and take the halo color 4 when the win color is the halo color

a 9 by 5 grid whose key and 1 by 1 card each hold a solid 0 block, more cells than the 8 background: the concept calls the card slot and wins, painting the status row 3; the commonest color is 0, so under the derived background the full row of 8 at row 8 is a third divider and the model is undefined
train0 input shifted one column right: the concept reads the shifted slot bands and wins on card row 1; the stored bands cut every slot one column off, call nothing, and lose

train0 input with the card slots at rows 13-15, cols 17-19 and rows 8-10, cols 7-9 swapped: the concept calls the solid 0 block at its new slot in row 0 and loses; the stored card calls the old slot, completes row 1, and wins

train0 input flipped top to bottom: the concept finds the key panel at the bottom and wins on card row 1; the stored side reads the empty top panel as the key, which has no band of slots, and is undefined
train0 input with both divider lines recolored 5: the concept finds the dividers as full lines of one color and wins; the stored divider color 6 finds no divider and is undefined
